description: UNOSAT Gaza Strip Road Network Comprehensive Damage Assessment - August 2024 is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: CE20231007PSE This map illustrates a satellite imagery-based damage assessment to detect damage and affected roads across the Gaza Strip, Occupied Palestinian Territory, based on an image collected on 18 August 2024. Coverage: Palestine, State of. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are complex emergency-conflict-security, crisis-opt-israel-hostilities, geodata. It offers 1 resource(s) in GEODATABASE. The portal shows 2025-11-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
